name: Ramp
shortDescription: Finance platform with a free plan at $0 and Plus at $15 per user.
longDescription: Ramp's pricing page lists an AI-assisted Free plan at $0 per user per month and Plus at $15 per user per month plus a platform fee based on team size.
pricingNotes: Free is $0 per user per month. Plus is $15 per user per month plus a platform fee.
bestFor: Card, expense, and finance workflows on a listed free plan
notIdealFor: A company that wants Plus without reading the platform fee
strength: Ramp lists an AI-assisted free plan at $0 per user per month and Plus at $15 per user per month.
weakness: Plus adds a platform fee based on team size, so $15 is not an all-in company price.

useCaseFit.finance-ops: Finance platform with a free plan at $0 per user and Plus at $15 per user.
